gaps: The fixed ASTRO BOT reference benchmark remains not passed. Improvements over this repository do not prove a preference over the reference.
Fresh independent critics, ultracode and a blind reference comparison were unavailable; this iteration is author self-review.
Square landing tops, sparse distant terrain and a conservative small cast scale remain visible. More authored scene composition and motion polish are needed.
The campaign still has one generated route per floor; alternative route selection remains unfinished.
Final stills report 31 textures. The software-rendered recording has an observed maximum frame gap of 2,733ms. Hardware FPS, long GPU-memory soak and smooth high-quality motion remain unverified.
Broader accessibility/comprehension and audio listening remain open; the existing two high-severity toolchain audit findings were not changed.
The progress page records evidence; it is not a background agent scheduler. No production deployment or live audience-operation approval is claimed.

A redundant pre-publication catalogue-wide rerun was stopped by the 200-second command timeout after printing 457 passing subtests and no summary. It is incomplete, not a second full-suite pass; the completed 549/549 result above is retained with its log. A subsequent focused rerun completed 46/46 and the browser build passed.
